subject: [RFC PATCH 4/6] mm/mempolicy: plumb alloc_flags through folio allocation

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch adds an alloc_flags argument to the MM-internal policy allocator and carries it through preferred-many, huge-page, and general policy allocation paths in the NUMA policy allocation code. The public mempolicy folio interface remains as an ALLOC_DEFAULT wrapper. Non-task requests bypass task policy selection and use the supplied preferred node directly. No existing caller behavior is changed.
